title: Initiate Navigator: Compact checklist, zero-state frames, and contextual tips for console first-touch
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and prepare visual assets and interaction specs for a compact 'navigator' checklist overlay and updated zero-state screens. Deliver Figma artboards and screenshot-ready PNGs for the 2025.03 console release. Focus: reduce time-to-first-success for new users without modal-heavy flows; make tips skippable, persistent, and telemetry-friendly.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with artboards for desktop (1280–1920) and tablet (768–1024) with named frames for each checklist step
Exported PNG/JPEG assets for marketing/release notes (hero + 3 step screenshots) in the shared Drive folder
Interaction spec doc covering states: closed, open, snoozed, completed, and dismissed with keyboard accessibility notes
Design handoff ticket with CSS variables and component tokens; engineering can implement without further design clarifications
Usability sign-off from PM (Evan Patel) after 3 moderated sessions with internal testers
comments: 2025-02-18 Maya Chen: Initial ticket created. Goal is a low-friction orientation layer that surfaces 3 measurable actions and their next steps. Avoid a multi-modal wizard to prevent drop-off.

2025-02-21 Omar Rodriguez: Wireframes uploaded to Figma. Proposing a compact left-anchored flyout anchored to the primary nav with 'snooze' and 'finish' affordances. See frames 'flyout-compact' and 'flyout-expanded'.

2025-02-24 Evan Patel (PM): Prefer progressive disclosure — only show detailed tips after user clicks 'Learn more' to keep cognitive load low. Request: add a lightweight progress indicator and an optional 'skip for 7 days' persistence option.

2025-02-26 Lara Kim (Eng): Technical note — anchoring to left nav requires a small layout change to persistent-nav z-index. I'll draft a minimal CSS module and an experiment flag. Also need telemetry event names from Product.

2025-03-01 Design review: Accessibility feedback from QA: ensure 4.5:1 contrast for tip text; add focus trap escape instructions and keyboard shortcut '?' to open navigator. Priya Nair provided visual approval pending contrast adjustments.
2025-03-04 Omar Rodriguez: Updated artboards exported to Drive. Added dark-mode variants and retina PNGs. Included component token mapping (spacing, color, radius) in the handoff sheet.

2025-03-06 Evan Patel: Conducted 3 internal moderated usability sessions. Outcome: users complete step 1 in 38s on average; requests to shorten microcopy on step 2. Marked copy edits and passed back to UX writer.
2025-03-07 Maya Chen: Tagging for In Review. Awaiting engineering estimate for A/B rollout and the feature flagging plan. Also need Product to finalize telemetry acceptance criteria.
decisions: Use compact left-anchored flyout instead of full-screen wizard to lower drop-off and preserve console context
Progressive disclosure: show a one-line hint for each step; expand to detailed tips only on user action
Persist snooze option as 'skip for 7 days' rather than permanent dismiss to support re-onboarding
Expose telemetry events: navigator_shown, navigator_step_shown, navigator_step_completed, navigator_snoozed, navigator_dismissed
Provide both light and dark assets and ensure 2x retina exports for release screenshots
notes: Trade-offs: compact flow reduces upfront education but may require more contextual tips spread across the console. Plan an A/B experiment (flagged rollout) to measure activation (first successful generation) and retention. Handoff package includes copy table for localization team (EN, FR, DE).
